facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa states that it is a network of field experts across 54 countries in Africa.
facts.quote: We are a Network of Field experts across 54 countries in Africa.

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa's Madagascar teams are coordinated from Antananarivo and cover Toamasina, Fianarantsoa, Mahajanga, and Antsiranana, plus all regions, according to the page.
facts.quote: Our teams operate across Madagascar’s regions, coordinated from Antananarivo,covering Toamasina, Fianarantsoa, Mahajanga, Antsiranana, and all regions.

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa's stated data collection methods for Madagascar research include CATI, CAPI, CAWI, and face-to-face research.
facts.quote: With extensive experience in CATI, CAPI, CAWI, and face-to-face research, we design and execute opinion polls and surveys

facts.fact: Fieldwork Africa's stated mission is to provide accurate data and quick turn-around at competitive market rates, with no specific price or turnaround figure given.
facts.quote: Our mission is to provide our clients with accurate data and quick turn-around at competitive market rates.
